record.paper_title: Open Problems on Eigenvalues of the Laplacian
record.original_question: Let Ω be a bounded domain in ℝⁿ. What is the optimal lower bound for the scale-invariant product |Ω|^{4/n} λ₁(Ω)λ₂(Ω), where λ₁ and λ₂ are the first two Dirichlet Laplacian eigenvalues? Likewise, if Ω is convex, what is the optimal lower bound for |Ω|^{2/n} λ₂(Ω)?

evidence.quote: Other problems suggested by the line of development above would be to find the best lower bound for |Ω|^{4/n} λ₁(Ω)λ₂(Ω), or for |Ω|^{2/n} λ₂(Ω) when Ω is convex.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ be a bounded domain, and let $0<\lambda_1(\Omega)\le\lambda_2(\Omega)\le\cdots$ denote the eigenvalues of the Dirichlet Laplacian, i.e. the eigenvalues of the problem
$$-\Delta u=\lambda u\text{ in }\Omega,\qquad u=0\text{ on }\partial\Omega.$$
Write $|\Omega|$ for the $n$-dimensional Lebesgue measure of $\Omega$. The quantities $|\Omega|^{4/n}\lambda_1(\Omega)\lambda_2(\Omega)$ and $|\Omega|^{2/n}\lambda_2(\Omega)$ are scale invariant.

(a) Determine the sharp constant
$$C_1(n)=\inf_{\Omega}\,|\Omega|^{4/n}\,\lambda_1(\Omega)\,\lambda_2(\Omega),$$
where the infimum is taken over all bounded domains $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, and identify the extremal domains (if any).

(b) Determine the sharp constant
$$C_2(n)=\inf_{\Omega\text{ convex}}\,|\Omega|^{2/n}\,\lambda_2(\Omega),$$
where the infimum is taken over all bounded convex domains $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, and identify the extremal domains (if any).
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not locate a sharp lower bound for either of these scale-invariant quantities. While many related results exist (Faber–Krahn for $|\Omega|^{2/n}\lambda_1$, Ashbaugh–Benguria for the ratio $\lambda_2/\lambda_1$, Pólya-type lower bounds, and recent work on the Ashbaugh–Benguria conjectures), no reference establishing the optimal lower bound for $|\Omega|^{4/n}\lambda_1\lambda_2$ over general bounded domains or for $|\Omega|^{2/n}\lambda_2$ over convex domains was found, so the problems appear to remain open.

status_evidence.title: A sharp bound for the ratio of the first two eigenvalues of Dirichlet Laplacians and extensions
status_evidence.snippet: Ashbaugh–Benguria proof of the Payne–Pólya–Weinberger conjecture on λ₂/λ₁.
status_evidence.claim: Sharp bounds are known for the ratio λ₂/λ₁ but not for the products with volume considered here.

status_evidence.title: Isoperimetric inequalities for eigenvalues of the Laplacian and the Schrödinger operator
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of isoperimetric eigenvalue inequalities including Faber–Krahn and Krahn–Szegő.
status_evidence.claim: Sharp lower bounds for |Ω|^{2/n}λ₂ over convex Ω and |Ω|^{4/n}λ₁λ₂ are not listed as resolved.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems on Eigenvalues of the Laplacian
status_evidence.snippet: Collection posing open problems on Dirichlet/Neumann Laplacian eigenvalues.
status_evidence.claim: These optimal lower bounds are listed among open problems.
